slides.text:
The last parameter can be written `...type`. It accepts any number of values, even none, and inside the function it is a plain slice of that type. It must come last.

The snippet is pseudo code, not Go.

To pass a slice you already have, put `...` after it. The slice's type must match exactly.

`any` is a type that accepts a value of any type, so `...any` takes mixed values, as `Printf` does.
